name: Pastor Appreciation
overview: Scripture reveals that pastors are divinely appointed shepherds who feed the flock with knowledge and understanding, reflecting God's heart for His people as promised in Jeremiah 3:15. Their role is essential for the proclamation of the gospel, as faith comes through hearing the message delivered by preachers (Romans 10:14). The beauty and blessing of those who bring good news and salvation is celebrated in Isaiah 52:7 and Numbers 6:24, emphasizing the Lord’s favor upon them. Ephesians 4:11 further highlights that pastors are gifts from Christ, given to equip and build up the church.
